narrative.rotation_signal: Clear accumulation into mega-cap tech (NVDA, AVGO, AAPL, GOOG, AMZN, NFLX, INTC, CSCO), financials (BAC, AXP), and consumer (HD, PG) — with distribution out of META, AMD, KLAC, LLY, WFC, and PEP. Semis are bifurcating: NVDA/AVGO/INTC/TXN bid, AMD/KLAC sold. Financials bifurcate the same way: BAC/AXP bid, WFC/MS sold — a quality-tier rotation within sectors, not a sector-level move.
narrative.diverging_from_industry_layer: META bearish here despite communication services typically tracking with GOOG/NFLX strength — watch for single-name idiosyncratic pressure. INTC bullish (9.32) while AMD/KLAC bearish — Top 50 sees INTC as the semi contrarian long, not the broad semis trade. LLY bearish while MRK bullish signals pharma is being traded name-by-name, not as a group.
